notes: The two smaller sizes (NP_02 s2.1-s2.2) as data. A SCRAP is one micro-objective from data/scrap_objectives.v1.json over a hard 30s cap with no Tension meter: objective met = win, a constraint broken = loss, the cap = judged on EP. A SPAR is one 90s segment with full EP and DROPs, the personal meter capped at 50 (hissatsu practicable, transforms locked) and lab flags. Opponents are boss patterns; a stand-in pattern by style carries an NPC card's strings when the card is not a boss (the greybox has no assembler). Ep1's bouts run by name.

lab_flags.infinite_stamina: the combo lab: your stamina never drops
lab_flags.tell_highlight: his tells outlined (Scout Book knowledge as UI); XP -50%
lab_flags.mirror: fight a copy of your own fighter (not in the greybox: the boss agent runs patterns, not profiles)
